name: Kowai Monogatari
source:
A young man came to, standing alone in the dark woods...
"Who am I?" With no memory and no direction, he seeks shelter in a strange old mansion that appears before him...

Inside the walls there are four rules... four stories... 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE085605.html]DLsite[/url]]
